methodology.protocol_retries: Expected trapped-choice rejection discovery is reported separately as protocol retries and total trapped rejected choices, not as illegal actions. Unexpected server rejections remain errors.
methodology.A: frozen pokedecision-v0 greedy turn policy + random-default preview
methodology.T: same frozen greedy turn policy + learned argmax preview
methodology.no_leakage: Preview inputs contain own species/moves/abilities/items and public opponent species only; no hidden opponent sets, future turns, or outcomes are inputs.
methodology.pairing: Exact player/opponent team identities and packed-team SHA256s must match by matchup_index; both arms use the same schedule_seed.
methodology.rng_caveat: Showdown and heuristic RNG are uncontrolled. This pairs team schedules, not simulator trajectories or opponent actions.
methodology.intervals: Two-sided 95% Wilson win-rate intervals and seeded paired percentile bootstrap T-A; ties count as non-wins.
methodology.validity: Exact requested attempted/completed counts, zero errors and illegal actions in both arms, and complete exact team pairing.
